limitations: The Government guide lists eight active postcodes but is not a current versioned assignment, alias, validity, correction, exception and explicit non-area denominator.
Prose locality and post-office coverage is not Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry and cannot be converted without an authoritative crosswalk, compatible rights and topology method.
The Statistics Department open licence is limited to its own data and does not prove Postal Service or Physical Planning reuse/public-serving rights.
The official Physical Planning page provides a spatial-data request path, not a downloadable postcode geometry artifact or permission grant.
The real MS API returned unsupported and the running app displayed no MS postal area, class, source, date or confidence.
